Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

leave no stone unturned phrase

also do everything possible, try everything, spare no effort, not fail in anything

classical

Cic. Fam. 16.4: adhūc dum mihi nūllō locō deesse vīs, numquam tē cōnfirmāre potuistī (Lewis & Short), s.v. adhūc
Traupman 102
Traupman 338

nūllō locō deesse

dēsum with nūllō locō, “in no place, at no point”

fail at no point, leave nothing undone

Cicero to Tiro, who was so eager not to fail him in anything that he never got well. The dē- of deesse is short before the vowel.

Other words

  • nihil praetermittere — leave nothing undone, leave no stone unturned

    praetermittō, praetermittere, praetermīsī, praetermissum · classical · Cic. Att. 9.2a.1: quam nihil praetermittis in cōnsiliō dandō! (Lewis & Short); Traupman 108

    Literally “to let nothing pass by”.

Examples

  • Nihil praetermittam.

    I will leave no stone unturned.Traupman 108

See also fail.
